lines.en: I know the muddy swamp water.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水，浑得正好藏身。
lines.en: Swamp water is murky enough to hide me.

lines.zh: 红树根下的水，老拽我偏。
lines.en: The water under the roots keeps dragging me off.
Circling the mangroves, back here again.

lines.zh: 这条泥沟，我游了无数遍。
lines.en: This muddy channel — I've swum it countless times.
Something moves under the sand.

lines.zh: 别拦我，我要去更深的地方。
lines.en: Don't block me, I want deeper water.
Easy — the snails in the silt are asleep.
Kick off the mud and flick — gone.
Who's thrashing the bottom? It's all silt.
Along the muddy bottom, I sway my tail.
Stay close. Stragglers get swallowed.

lines.zh: 咕噜，沼泽的水面在唱歌。
lines.en: Gurgle, the swamp surface is singing.
Swamp water pushes me along.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的鱼群，挤成一团。
lines.en: The swamp school packs tight.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥水里，我们成群。
lines.en: In swamp mud we school together.
Shards of light on the surface. Dazzling.
The water turns, and so do I.
Sunlight on my scales — very bright.

lines.zh: 等我的鱼群从根下过来。
lines.en: Waiting for my school to come through the roots.

lines.zh: 红树林的根下，我慢慢游。
lines.en: Under mangrove roots I drift slowly.
Rubbing the mossy stone, my scales cool.

lines.zh: 我一吐，泡就浮上去破了。
lines.en: I breathe out; the bubble rises and pops.
Murky swamp water suits me.
Swamp water, warm and murky.

lines.zh: 红树林的根下，是我的家。
lines.en: Under the mangrove roots is my home.
The water nudges; I rock once.
Drifting with the current, fins at rest.
Water fleas, snail eggs, or algae?

lines.zh: 水面就在头顶，我该上去了。
lines.en: The surface is right above. Time to go up.

lines.zh: 叶缝里落下一线光，我停在里头。
lines.en: A thread of light through the leaves — I rest in it.
The me on the surface looks brighter.

lines.zh: 沼泽水里，我的鳞是黄的。
lines.en: In swamp water my scales run yellow.

lines.zh: 你脚边的水，我绕还是不绕。
lines.en: The water by your feet — go around or not?
Dry mud on your boots — from the bank.
Will this flake trade for something?
You're not from the wreck, are you?
Sunny? I'll remember that.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，眼珠跟着我。
lines.en: You squat on the bank, eyes following me.
Two legs in the mud — strange.
You stay dry; I stay wet.

lines.zh: 你手伸这么长，是要捞我？
lines.en: Reaching that far in — are you netting me?
Under my scales it burns. I circle.

lines.zh: 我游起来歪了，鱼群都散了。
lines.en: I swim crooked now, and the school scatters.

lines.zh: 泥水一浑，我就看不见了。
lines.en: The mud clouds and I lose sight.
Once more and I'll bury in the mud.
Don't come close. My mouth is still open.

lines.zh: 你出手太快，我鳞都炸了。
lines.en: You struck too fast. My scales flared.

lines.zh: 红树的根缝，我钻得进去。
lines.en: The gaps between mangrove roots fit me.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水浑了，是我的血。
lines.en: The swamp water clouded — that is my blood.
There's a mark on my scales. Noted.

lines.zh: 掉了一片金鳞，沉下去了。
lines.en: A gold scale came off and sank.
I'll taste and let go. Not greedy.
That bait is worth a swim.

lines.zh: 那影子不像鱼，也不像虫。
lines.en: That shape's no fish, no bug.
I circle the murky swamp water.

lines.zh: 顺着这点腥味，我游过整片沼泽。
lines.en: Following that faint smell, I crossed the whole swamp.
Shrimp smell drifts through the mud. I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 我身上的金，是太阳给的。
lines.en: The sun gave me this gold.
Fine. I'll swim over and take it.
That red worm sways at my mouth.
So shiny. Can I swallow it?
Harder than a swamp stone.
Hey, you kicked mud in my face!

lines.zh: 你走岸上，我钻根下，行吗。
lines.en: You take the bank, I take the roots. Deal?
One bump and I spun in circles.

lines.zh: 我还没你的巴掌大，别撞。
lines.en: I'm not even palm-sized. Easy!
One bump and my bubbles scattered.
Clear the mangrove roots — I'm coming through.
Who's charging through the root gaps?
One stride and the water rises.
We crowd under the roots.

lines.zh: 鱼群一撞，我晕了一会儿。
lines.en: The school bumped me and I spun.
You bent a corner of my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 你鳞上的黄，像晒暖的水。
lines.en: The gold on your scales looks like sun-warmed water.
Down this muddy channel, together.
Under the roots I cleared a hollow.

lines.zh: 沼泽的浑水里，我成群游。
lines.en: In the swamp's murk, I swim in schools.
The arc of your tail — lovely.
Two tails, one rhythm.
A shell from the marsh. For you.
A swamp full of fish, and I want you.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水这么浑，我们正好藏。
lines.en: The swamp water is murky; we hide well.
Two circles around you — that's my courtship.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的东西，能用就留。
lines.en: Swamp finds — keep what's useful.
Hard, not a scale.

lines.zh: 谁把陆上的东西丢水里。
lines.en: Who dropped dry-land stuff in the water?

lines.zh: 搬开石子，底下压着这个。
lines.en: I nudged the stone aside. This was under it.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满了，鳃都合不上。
lines.en: My mouth's full. My gills won't close.
Fished out of the swamp. Mine for now.
Anything that glints, I take first.
Take this shell. Trade me for it.
This bright scale goes in my nest.
Hold it in my mouth, stash it under the roots.
Gills flare. My eyes are on you.

lines.zh: 你靴子边的水纹，骗不了我。
lines.en: The ripple by your boot does not fool me.
The bank is narrow. Where will you run?

lines.zh: 我在红树根间穿来穿去。
lines.en: I thread between mangrove roots.
Fins folded, body coiled — away.
One ring of ripples, one chance.
A fish shadow flickered. I'm after it.
Muddy swamp water suits me.
The marsh water is muddy; perfect.
Flush with the mud, still unseen.
The mud you crushed keeps bubbling.
It rounds the roots; so do I.
Even to the bottom of the mud, I follow.
Mud to your waist — you can't swim.

lines.zh: 我可以跟着水纹等一天。
lines.en: I can follow a ripple all day.

lines.zh: 追小鱼没意思，追你才够。
lines.en: Chasing minnows is dull. You'll do.
Running on the bank, already out of breath.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水替我数着一二三。
lines.en: The swamp water counts one, two, three for me.
Two more flicks of the tail and I'm there.

lines.zh: 哪条根下能藏，我全知道。
lines.en: I know every root that hides a fish.
Small teeth, but they hold flesh.
Swamp water is just warm enough.

lines.zh: 沼泽的鱼，尾巴还能拍一下。
lines.en: This swamp fish can flick its tail once more.
That bite was barely a third of my strength.
Stop thrashing in my mouth; you'll jam my gills.
A row of small teeth. Once I bite, I hold.

lines.zh: 用吻骨顶你膝盖，站不稳吧。
lines.en: My jaw hits your knee — hard to stand, yes?
One gulp of swamp water and it's gone.
This muddy ditch is my ground.

lines.zh: 水里掉头，我比你快半拍。
lines.en: Turning underwater, I'm half a beat faster.
One lap along the roots to learn the way.
This is the swamp. The water's yellow as tea.
The mangrove water pushes me along.

lines.zh: 红树根下面，光是一格一格的。
lines.en: Under the mangrove roots the light comes in squares.
Popping up in the murk — anyone about?
Do not eat me; I am only this big.

lines.zh: 我从红树根之间钻出来。
lines.en: I slip out between mangrove roots.
One lap around the roots to see who's here.

lines.zh: 我们成群，把水都染黄了。
lines.en: In schools, we turn the water yellow.
Mouth open, water in, through the gills. Done.

lines.zh: 烫！沼泽的水都快烧开了！
lines.en: Hot! The swamp water is nearly boiling!
Under the mangrove roots I hug the bottom.
There's no water here. My gills are burning.
The water bucked. My head rings.
One splash and the arrow comes.
This light has heated the water.
Belly empty — even my tail drags.
Lightning hit the water and my scales tingle.
Sinking, and my gills are empty.
